# Cynorida

> Cynorida is a cybersecurity company. We run managed detection and response, incident response and authorised offensive security testing for organisations that want to see every step of the work.

Analysts work from the telemetry a client already collects, contain threats only through playbooks the client has approved, and record every step in a console both teams share. Offensive testing starts only after written authorisation and a signed scope.

## Services

- [Managed detection and response](https://cynorida.com/services/managed-detection-and-response/)
- [Incident response](https://cynorida.com/services/incident-response/)
- [Threat hunting](https://cynorida.com/services/threat-hunting/)
- [Detection engineering](https://cynorida.com/services/detection-engineering/)
- [Penetration testing](https://cynorida.com/services/penetration-testing/)
- [Red teaming](https://cynorida.com/services/red-teaming/)
